CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION collect_ops.receipt_exception_quota_available(p_kind text, p_source uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare run uuid;collection uuid;begin
 if p_kind='receipt_event'then
  select e.collection_id into collection from collect_hybrid.receipt_business_events e where id=p_source;
  select x.run_id into run from collect_receipt_operations.run_events x where x.event_id=p_source and x.code='QUOTA_EXHAUSTED'order by x.recorded_at desc,x.run_id desc limit 1;
 else
  select s.collection_id into collection from collect_hybrid.momo_balance_snapshots s where id=p_source;
  select x.run_id into run from(
   (select b.run_id,b.recorded_at from collect_receipt_operations.backlog_results b where b.snapshot_id=p_source and b.code='QUOTA_EXHAUSTED'order by b.recorded_at desc,b.run_id desc limit 1)
   union all(select b.run_id,b.recorded_at from collect_ops.receipt_backlog_budget_deferrals b where b.snapshot_id=p_source order by b.recorded_at desc,b.run_id desc limit 1))x order by x.recorded_at desc,x.run_id desc limit 1;
 end if;return collect_ops.receipt_exception_run_budget_available(run,collection);end$function$
